name: Nadia Haddad
role: Analytics lead, formerly at a fintech scale-up
bio: Nadia has spent ten years turning messy event data into decisions. She ran analytics for a payments company through three pricing changes and now teaches product teams to answer their own questions with SQL.

name: Mateo Alvarez
bio: Mateo builds design systems for product teams of five to five hundred. He cares about naming, documentation and the boring decisions that make interfaces feel consistent.

name: Sam Whitfield
bio: Sam has led product teams in health tech and developer tools. Sam's courses are about talking to customers early and writing down decisions so the whole team can move.

name: Grace Okonkwo
bio: Grace went from senior engineer to managing three teams in four years. She coaches new managers on one-to-ones, feedback and running meetings people do not dread.
